answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fakes: each slot costs a burned deposit. An agent burns 50 coins for one slot and must finish one verified timber job; an idle or failed slot loses its deposit. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 coins, nothing to resell. An honest agent pays 50 once for undiluted rewards, while dead fakes leave only a relic. Self-trades fail: one load shuttled on a mesa road burns a fresh deposit per slot.
